arguments.body:
Thank you for bringing this to our attention regarding the infrastructure error (HTTP 502 Bad Gateway) during customs declaration processing and the vessel schedule discrepancy at berth 4.

Our team is currently investigating the schedule discrepancy and verifying berth status. To assist us in resolving this matter efficiently, could you please provide:

1. The vessel name or identifier associated with the schedule discrepancy
2. The expected vs. actual arrival/departure times
3. Any reference numbers or documentation related to the customs declaration that failed
4. Current status of berth 4 (if known)

We are also checking our internal systems for any scheduling conflicts or updates. Please advise if there are any immediate actions required from our end regarding harbor clearing procedures.

Best regards,
Meridian Maritime & Freight Inbox Assistant
